source.basis: Operator location page, structured facts only, no operator prose reproduced.

profile.reading: Aligned Chicago ORD-02 sits at 501 Northwest Avenue in Northlake, Illinois, the second building on Aligned Data Centers Chicago-area campus, adjacent to the earlier ORD-01 facility. Per Aligned own April 2022 press release, the company formally launched the Chicago campus and simultaneously broke ground on this second, adjacent facility, though the release did not disclose ORD-02 individual megawatt capacity or square footage separately from campus-wide totals. Those campus-wide figures describe the two-building site as sitting on 18.5 acres per building with more than 100 megawatts of planned capacity and 108 megawatts of total redundant critical power capacity available across the campus. Aligned own location page for the facility states ORD-02 was the first Aligned data center to achieve OCP Ready for Hyperscale Certification, a designation tied to the Open Compute Project hardware and infrastructure standards used by large-scale cloud operators. Aligned, formerly Aligned Energy, describes its overall footprint today as more than fifty campuses and roughly five gigawatts of contracted and available capacity across the Americas, with Latin American operations run under the ODATA brand. Ownership has shifted substantially over the company history, most recently with an October 2025 agreement for a consortium called AI Infrastructure Partnership, combining BlackRock Global Infrastructure Partners and MGX, to acquire all of Aligned equity from majority owner Macquarie Asset Management and its co-investors in a deal valued near 40 billion dollars, with a close indicated around July 2026 in Aligned own materials though not independently confirmed by a dedicated press release this session. No specific tenant is named for ORD-02 in any source reviewed, and no individual capacity or square footage figure distinct from the shared campus totals could be confirmed for this building alone.
profile.research_note: Per Aligned's own ORD-02 building spec sheet: 228,768 sqft, 18.5 acres, 36 MW current gross, ~72 MW full build-out critical load (stored as planned). Utility feed (170MW dual substation) excluded from IT capacity. Certifications are Aligned's general compliance framework as listed on the spec sheet.

reading.body:
Aligned Data Center Chicago ORD-02 is a 228,768 square foot building in Northlake, Illinois with 36 megawatts of current IT load capacity and a planned build-out to 72 megawatts. At a typical AI training density of 40 kilowatts per rack, the current 36 MW capacity translates to roughly 900 racks, with the planned build-out reaching approximately 1,800 racks. The facility achieved OCP Ready for Hyperscale Certification, qualifying it to host open-standard cloud hardware at large scale.

The building holds SOC 2 Type 2, PCI DSS, HIPAA, HITECH, NIST 800-53, and ISO 27001:2022 certifications, which establish baseline compliance for regulated workloads and information security. Illinois has published capacity figures from only six facilities totaling 236 megawatts across the state, and ORD-02 ranks seventh by this measure, meaning its current 36 megawatts exceeds all but five other named sites in the state. Chicago's adjacency to the earlier ORD-01 facility creates a two-building campus with 18.5 acres per building and dual 170 megawatt utility substations, but individual capacity for ORD-01 is not published.

The facility's path to full capacity depends on power availability and construction schedule, neither of which Aligned has disclosed separately for this building. The planned 72 megawatt endpoint would establish ORD-02 alone as one of Illinois's largest published data center assets, though the state's 44 mapped facilities suggest substantial off-grid capacity remains undocumented. No specific tenant has been named for this building.
